description: This file provides encoding helper functions written in shell script, including checks for UTF-16 and UTF-32 BOM prerequisites and functions to write UTF-16 and UTF-32 encoded output using iconv.

methods.name: write_utf16
methods.description: Outputs UTF-16 encoded data, includes BOM if prerequisites are met.

methods.name: write_utf32
methods.description: Outputs UTF-32 encoded data, includes BOM if prerequisites are met.
